title: operations.inventory.count_line.counted
description: A worker recorded a physical count for one bucket of a session (ADR-0026 §6) — either a line already on the session's open-time snapshot, or a new `is_unlisted` line for a bucket nothing was expected at. `counted_milli`/`expected_milli` are integer milli-units of the item's UOM, the same scale `operations.inventory.stock.posted` uses. Nothing has posted to the ledger yet; that only happens on `count_line.discrepancy_approved`, or never, if the count matched what was expected.
